title: recall counts each run's hits over its own cutoff, split by hmmer's domains
body:
## What exists today

`recall parse summary` reads `scores.tbl` and writes `summary.tbl`, one row per run. It counts each run's hits as a fraction of hmmer's: `sens`, `sens_dom` and `sens_seq` all divide by the pairs hmmer scored over its own cutoff. On the 15 October cutoffs nail reports more pairs over its cutoff than hmmer does, so a fraction of hmmer's hits no longer describes it.

## Proposal

`recall parse coverage` reads `scores.tbl` and writes `coverage.tbl`: one row per run, counting the pairs it reported at or above its own family cutoff, at `--c 2`. hmmer gets two rows: one with its sequence score against `hmmer_3`, one with its best domain against `hmmer_dom_3`. Each row splits its count three ways:

- hmmer's best domain on the pair clears `hmmer_dom_3`
- hmmer reported the pair, and no domain clears it
- hmmer did not report the pair

Families with no cutoff for some tool are left out, as nail-benchmarks-8add63 decided. A `#= left_out` line counts the families and, per tool, the pairs it reported in them. `parse scores` keeps a row for every reported pair in such a family, so that count is complete.

notes.author: jackroddy/6422e305
notes.text:
The full run finished on 27 Oct 2026, over all 1000 MGnify shards on the 15 October cutoffs at `--c 2`. `parse scores` took 527 s at 48 threads and `parse coverage` took 716 s on one thread. The table is `sets/recall/analysis/coverage.tbl`.

| run | hits | dom_over | dom_under | no_hmmer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| hmmer_dom | 2,114,381,548 | 2,114,381,548 | 0 | 0 |
| nail-s12.0 | 2,088,699,612 | 2,049,507,767 | 33,373,741 | 5,818,104 |
| nail-s10.0 | 2,038,587,022 | 2,002,043,039 | 31,275,600 | 5,268,383 |
| hmmer | 1,987,290,598 | 1,890,974,727 | 96,315,871 | 0 |
| nail-s9.0 | 1,948,071,943 | 1,915,552,479 | 28,209,684 | 4,309,780 |
| mmseqs-s12.0-ms2000 | 1,682,924,653 | 1,602,877,320 | 76,237,725 | 3,809,608 |
| mmseqs-s7.5-ms2000 | 1,545,724,952 | 1,481,512,004 | 61,220,886 | 2,992,062 |

The 14 families left out held 21,427 hmmer hits and none from nail or mmseqs. `summary.tbl` was not rebuilt and still reflects the 12 October cutoffs.
